name: Native Overview
author: Ömer Eren
description: Find the window you lost across workspaces. Search by app or title, preview it live, then press Enter to jump there or Ctrl+M to bring it here. Ctrl+Space filters the current workspace; the clear button resets your search. Match multiple words in any order. Open: omarchy-shell shell toggle leviathan.native-overview '{}'. Runs inside Omarchy Quattro. No shortcut is installed automatically. Finds existing windows, not apps to launch.
